_comment: DRISHTI Catalyst Connections (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 19). Connections manages OAuth/OIDC token lifecycle for a compatible third-party/AWS integration. Created in Console -> Connections (no CLI). Enabled via DRISHTI_USE_CATALYST_CONNECTIONS + DRISHTI_AWS_CONNECTION_ID.

connections.name: aws-model-adapter
connections.gap_note: The protected AWS model adapter (app/predict/adapter.py) currently authenticates with an HMAC-signed service request, NOT OAuth/OIDC. Per the matrix, Connections is USED only when the integration exposes OAuth/OIDC; until then this signed-service-auth gap is recorded honestly rather than claiming an unused OAuth connection.
connections.activate_when: the AWS API Gateway adapter is fronted by an OAuth/OIDC authorizer (e.g., Cognito) — then set oauth_ready=true, provision the Connection, and app/connections.py returns a real bearer token.
